name: Borys Budka-Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the renewal of the Agreement on cooperation in science and technology between the European Community and Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should keep its science and technology cooperation agreement with Ukraine running for another five years. The agreement was first signed in 2002 and has already been renewed four times. Renewing it means researchers in the EU and Ukraine can carry on working together on shared priorities such as new materials, information technology, physics, energy and medicine. Nothing in the agreement itself changes; it simply continues as before.

- The EU-Ukraine science and technology agreement is extended for five more years, with no change to its content.
- It affects researchers and research bodies in the European Union and Ukraine who work together.
- The Council can now formally adopt the renewal, since Parliament has given its consent.
